class.name: OcgGraphic3dCullingtool
class.brief_description: Graphic3d_CullingTool class provides a possibility to store parameters of view volume, such as its vertices and equations, and contains methods detecting if given AABB overlaps view volume.
class.description: ! Graphic3d_CullingTool class provides a possibility to store parameters of view volume, ! such as its vertices and equations, and contains methods detecting if given AABB overlaps view ! volume.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates an empty selector object with parallel projection type by default.

method.name: SetViewVolume
method.description: Retrieves view volume's planes equations and its vertices from projection and world-view matrices.

method.name: CacheClipPtsProjections
method.description: Caches view volume's vertices projections along its normals and AABBs dimensions. Must be called at the beginning of each BVH tree traverse loop.

method.name: WorldViewMatrix
method.description: Returns current world view transformation matrix.

method.name: WorldViewProjState
method.description: Returns state of current world view projection transformation matrices.

method.name: SignedPlanePointDistance
method.description: Calculates signed distance from plane to point.
